hr.pin_help: 4 to 6 digits, for punching on the shop's punch device. Keep it to yourself.
hr.new_pin_help: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.
hr.sign_in_help: Link the person's sign-in so they can punch from their phone and see their own attendance.
hr.work_help: Used to mark late arrival and leaving early. Leave both empty for no set hours.
hr.family_help: For example spouse and children. Only people allowed to see family details see this.
hr.salary_help: Only people allowed to see salaries see this.

hr.checks_waiting: {count, plural, one {# check waits} other {# checks wait}} for you
hr.rejected: Not accepted. The person sees your note.

hr.no_place: This phone's location isn't available. Turn location on and try again.
hr.place_filled: Filled in (to within {accuracy} m). Save to keep it.
hr.radius_help: How far from the shop a phone may punch.
hr.max_accuracy_help: A phone that only knows its place roughly is treated like one away from the shop.
hr.exception.check: Allowed with a reason; a manager checks it
hr.late_grace: Minutes before arriving counts as late
hr.early_grace: Minutes before leaving counts as early
hr.incomplete_after: Minutes after work ends before a missing punch out is marked

hr.clock_skew: Minutes a phone clock may be wrong before it is marked

hr.offline_max_age: Days a punch may wait on a phone

hr.offline_auto: Accept punches kept on a phone without a check

hr.make_device: Make this device a punch device
hr.device_ready: This device is now a punch device. Sign out to start punching on it.
hr.device_status_help: An inactive device can no longer punch or see the staff list.
hr.stop_this_device_body: This device will show the sign-in screen again. To stop it for good, also set it inactive in the list.
hr.device_stopped: This device is no longer a punch device.
hr.kiosk_empty: Nobody can punch here yet. A manager sets each person's punch PIN in Staff.
